answer: A sponsor stakes reputation and a 70-credit bond on a willow grove, filing a velvet dye report: a willow-bark batch and opal seal, key-bound in the public ledger. Auditors replay it: a missing report, reused serial, or mismatched opal seal costs 10 reputation; three bad reports burn it. Backing: 36, then 36+4(k-1) per grove; 1,000 fakes pay 2,034,000/epoch vs a 40,000 pool. Rented sponsors over five groves are flagged. Honest sponsors pay 36.
